judged_text: TopicEmbed.import interpolates the embed_url directly into HTML — `"#{url}"` — after only a scheme-prefix regex check (`^https?://`), splicing the unescaped URL into post content that the new raw_html cook path stores and renders without any sanitization. A feed item link (or Disqus thread link, or embeddable-host URL) containing quotes or angle brackets, e.g. `http://host/x'>`, becomes live script in the 'Imported from' footer of a raw_html post — stored XSS in the forum origin — and even benign URLs containing an apostrophe corrupt the rendered footer.

adjudication.rationale: In `TopicEmbed.import`, the code appends `contents << "...#{url}..."` after only checking `url =~ /^https?\:\/\//` (no HTML escaping). The created post is saved with `cook_method: Post.cook_methods[:raw_html]` and `Post#cook` returns `raw` directly for `:raw_html`, bypassing the normal cooking/sanitization pipeline. The embed view renders with `<%= raw post.cooked %>`. Therefore a crafted feed/disqus URL containing quotes/HTML can break out of the attribute and inject script, yielding stored XSS.
